# Feature: Fan tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #10 (Fan tile) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: pushes you one tile each second. Unique: only mover driven by real seconds, even with no input. Useful: punishes waiting and syncs movement to the timer. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** pushes you one tile each second.

**So that** punishes waiting and syncs movement to the timer.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Fan tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-10-fan-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: a fan-wind corridor crosses a crumbling tile, with a safe place to stand and read the room. A player who stands there to think is pushed a tile each second onto ground they did not choose, which teaches that the fan moves them even when they make no input at all. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Wind tiles push you one tile downwind every real second if that tile is free, even if you made no input
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Wind direction is marked on the tiles, so standing still is a move the fan makes for you

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Fan tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-10-fan-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #10.
